candidates.summary: A panic inside load kills the whole gnoweb process: DoChan runs load on its own goroutine and re-raises the panic there unrecoverably
candidates.failure_scenario: load runs on the goroutine DoChan starts, and golang.org/x/sync v0.21.0 singleflight re-raises a panic with `go panic(e)` once a DoChan waiter exists (singleflight.go:166-167, commented 'needs to ensure that this panic cannot be recovered'), so a panic anywhere in decode, sanitize, cover/icon or the operator's Trusted func terminates gnoweb, every realm page down, where net/http's per-connection recover would otherwise lose one request. No input reaching such a panic was found today (validCore bounds Palette, the /r/ or /p/ prefix guards pkgPath's slice, TruncMiddle and LastPathElement check lengths), so the risk is latent. Fix: recover inside the DoChan closure and return it as an error.
